title: Entity Drink Potion Behavior
description: Allows the mob to drink potions based on specified environment conditions.

potions.title: Potions
potions.description: A list of potions that this entity can drink. Each potion entry has the following parameters:

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

speed_modifier.title: Speed Modifier
speed_modifier.description: The movement speed modifier to apply to the entity while it is drinking a potion. A value of 0 represents no change in speed.
